items.sentence: Keep trying — that is the spirit!
The meeting is over — I will show you out.
items.translation: 会议结束了——我送你出去。

items.sentence: Sorry I missed dinner — something came up.
items.translation: 抱歉我没赶上晚饭——临时有事。

items.sentence: Do not believe it — I just made that up.
She canceled again — she is a bummer.
items.translation: 她又取消了——真让人扫兴。

items.sentence: I forgot my notes — I will just wing it.
items.translation: 我忘带讲稿了——只好即兴发挥。

items.sentence: Please talk to me — do not shut me out.
items.translation: 跟我说说话——别把我拒之门外。

items.sentence: Keep me updated on any changes.
Before we vote — do you want to weigh in here?
items.translation: 表决之前——你想说两句吗？

items.sentence: Give me a minute — it is a lot to take in.
items.translation: 让我缓一下——一时接受不了。

items.sentence: Get some rest — I will check on you later.
items.translation: 好好休息——我待会儿来看你。

items.sentence: I cannot add more meetings — I have a hectic schedule.
items.translation: 我没法再加会了——日程排得密不透风。

items.sentence: What is so funny — did I say something wrong?
items.translation: 有什么好笑的——我说错话了吗？

items.sentence: I cannot wait to see you again.
items.translation: 我迫不及待想再见到你。

items.sentence: Do not just stand there — back me up!
Do not mind me — I am not myself today.
items.translation: 别管我——我今天状态不好。
明天什么日子——有什么特别的吗？

items.sentence: Running into you here — what are the chances?
